title: BPS provincial GRDP (current prices) and population, Indonesia

columns.province_code: BPS province code (kode_bps); 00 = Indonesia. Names and Kemendagri codes in 'provinces'.
columns.sector: GRDP sector code (KBLI letter groups) or TOTAL; empty for population indicators.
columns.value: Number in the indicator's unit, as published by BPS. Multiply by 'multiplier' for base units.

province_source.note: BPS and Kemendagri codes differ for the six Papua provinces; join other datasets on the code system they use.

sectors.E: Pengadaan Air, Pengelolaan Sampah, Limbah dan Daur Ulang
sectors.G: Perdagangan Besar dan Eceran, Reparasi Mobil dan Sepeda Motor
sectors.O: Administrasi Pemerintahan, Pertahanan dan Jaminan Sosial Wajib

grdp_current.name: PDRB atas dasar harga berlaku (GRDP at current prices), Seri 2010
notes: BPS table note (page last updated 2026-08-05 07:05:09): Perbedaan antara jumlah PDRB 34 Provinsi dan PDB Indonesia antara lain disebabkan oleh diskrepansi statistik. Triwulan I–IV 2024 dan Tahun 2024: Angka sementara Triwulan I–IV 2025 dan Tahun 2025: Angka sangat sementara Triwulan I–II 2026 : Angka sangat sangat sementara Sumber: BPS, berbagai sensus, survei, dan sumber lain.

2020-2024 annual totals come from the compiled workbook raw/grdp-population/20261102_bps-province-grdp-population-2020-2025.xlsx, not yet from a BPS page; quarterly and sector values for those years need the BPS WebAPI.
BPS publishes no Indonesia row in this table; the sum of provincial GRDP is not national GDP.

population.name: Jumlah penduduk (population)
notes: 2020 = Sensus Penduduk 2020 (September); 2021-2022 = Proyeksi Penduduk Interim 2020-2023; 2023 onward = Proyeksi Penduduk Indonesia 2020-2050; all mid-year (June). See 'source_tables' for each year.
The change from the interim to the 2020-2050 projection between 2022 and 2023 can show as a population fall in 2023 that is not a real decline.

population_growth.name: Laju pertumbuhan penduduk per tahun (annual population growth rate)
notes: The base period differs by year (2020: 2010-2020; later years: from SP2020). See 'source_tables' for each year.

population_share.name: Distribusi persentase penduduk (share of national population)

population_density.name: Kepadatan penduduk (population density)
notes: The area basis differs by year (Permendagri 72/2019, later Kepmendagri 2022). See 'source_tables'.

notes: Papua split: Papua Barat Daya (92), Papua Selatan (95), Papua Tengah (96) and Papua Pegunungan (97) have values from 2024. For 2020-2023, Papua (94) and Papua Barat (91) are the pre-split provinces and are not comparable with 2024 onward.
For a consistent series: Papua (old) = 94 + 95 + 96 + 97; Papua Barat (old) = 91 + 92.
GRDP per capita (Rp million per person) = grdp_current (Rp billion) / population (thousand); not stored because it is derived.
